function: PPO agent jointly outputs UAV beamforming vector, RIS phase shifts and UAV trajectory increments to maximize average secrecy rate or minimize secrecy outage duration (p. 8-10).
system: RIS-aided mmWave A2G link: UAV base station with 4-antenna ULA, fixed 20 m altitude; phase-only reflecting RIS 4x4 elements; single-antenna Bob and Eve; 28 GHz (p. 3, 11).
method: Reinforcement learning: PPO actor-critic with clipped objective, LeakyReLU, tanh output; learning rates 3e-4, 500 episodes; trained by interaction, state from channel gains and UAV position (p. 8-11).
data_channel: Simulated mmWave LoS-dominant channel with path loss exponent kappa=1.8, complex Gaussian small-scale fading, NLoS paths omitted; custom model of [43], [44]; no dataset (p. 4, 11).
test_conditions: Single fixed geometry (Bob, Eve, RIS positions fixed); flight durations N=60, 80, 100 slots; no test in other positions, antennas, or RIS sizes (p. 11-13).
baselines: Non-learned: SCA-based alternating optimization (own Algorithm 1); learned: DDPG and SAC applied to the same MDP (p. 7, 11-13).
metrics: Sum and per-slot secrecy rate (bps/Hz), total reward, secrecy outage probability, Bob's transmission rate, running time, UAV trajectory (p. 11-14).
complexity: Table II running time: PPO 780.29, 763.86, 770.10 s for N=60, 80, 100 versus SCA 564.88, 1194.43, 1523.51 s; DDPG and SAC also listed (p. 11).
q1_support: p. 4: "we consider the following mmWave channel model in this paper [43], [44]". Missing: no 3GPP model or measured data; custom LoS-dominant model with path loss exponent from Table I (p. 11).
q2_support: p. 11: "We assume a ULA with 4 antennas is equipped by the UAV and the RIS has 4×4 elements". Missing: no test with other antennas, RIS size, positions or channel; only N and nu vary.
q3_support: p. 11: "the final total secrecy rate of Algorithm 2 is higher" than the SCA Algorithm 1; "PPO is able to achieve a higher total Rsec compared to the two reference DRL algorithms" (DDPG, SAC).
q4_support: p. 11: "the running time of programs is demonstrated in Table II, where SCA refers to Algorithm 1".
q5_support: p. 9: "the training data comes from the interaction between agent and environment". Missing: self-simulated environment, no code or data link, no public dataset.
notes: Areas 3 and 6 both fit (UAV beamformer and RIS phases, learned jointly with trajectory); area 6 chosen by the specificity order since the UAV is an aerial base station (p. 3); reviewer to confirm. Learned trajectory is joint with physical-layer decisions, so above_phy passes. Objective is secrecy rate or secrecy outage duration (p. 4).
